name: Staked USDS
oneLiner: stUSDS is Sky's risk-capital staking module over USDS funding SKY-backed borrowing; holders earn the stUSDS Rate and absorb shortfall and governance slashing.
collateral: USDS supplied to Sky's stUSDS risk-capital module, where deposits fund SKY-backed borrowing and earn the stUSDS Rate; holders absorb staked-SKY loan shortfall and governance slashing risk
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 NAV shares over USDS; users deposit USDS to mint stUSDS and withdraw USDS subject to unutilized module liquidity, while bad debt or governance slashing can reduce redeemable value

notices.title: No contract exit at full utilization; first loss on a book that cannot liquidate
notices.message: Holders can withdraw only USDS that SKY-backed Lockstake borrowers have not drawn. The module has been fully lent since about November 10, 2026, so contract withdrawals are effectively zero and the stUSDS Rate sits at its 50% maximum. Exit depends on about $3M of DEX liquidity, where stUSDS traded roughly 10% below its redemption value on November 24. Holders also absorb that book's losses first, and its liquidation auctions have been switched off since stUSDS launched: on November 24, $30.5M (19%) of the debt sat below the protocol's own safety price. The collateral is SKY, Sky's own governance token, and the largest borrower carries 47% of the debt.
